items.title: At a Safe Distance
items.captureMethod: HTMLCanvasElement.captureStream(24) with MediaRecorder. Cover from the same canvas.toBlob(image/png).
items.cameraMovement: Capture application dispatches bubbling KeyboardEvents to the actual canvas and its unmodified native window keydown handler. Native increments are 0.02 radians, scheduled on a 100 ms grid. The path goes from home to yaw -0.24 and returns to home, with a small pitch arc.
items.postCaptureNormalization: Complete runtime inventory serialized as Python json.dumps(packaged_files, sort_keys=True).encode(), then SHA256. Paths are relative to runtime/. Original browser metadata is preserved locally at .build/capture-browser.json.
